spans.s:
1. हुत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see under rt. ह्वे), of-
fered with fire, poured forth (as clarified butter in the
sacred fire), burnt as an oblation, sacrificed; one to
whom an oblation is offered; (अस्), m. epithet of
Śiva; (अम्), n. an oblation, offering, sacrifice.
—हुत-जातवेदस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one who has made
an oblation to fire.
—हुतभुक्-प्रिया, f. ‘dear to
Agni,’ the wife of Agni.
—हुत-भुज्, क्, m. ‘obla-
tion-eater,’ Agni or fire; epithet of a particular star.
—हुत-वह, अस्, m. ‘oblation-bearer,’ Agni or
fire.
—हुत-संविक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to
some) one who has sacrificed all his individuality or
blended his own will with the Universal Soul.
—हुत-
होम, अस्, m. a Brāhman who has offered an obla-
tion; (अम्), n. an offered oblation, burnt-offering.
—हुताग्नि (˚त-अग्˚), इस्, m. fire with which an
oblation is made, sacrificial fire.
—हुताश (˚त-आश),
अस्, m. ‘eating the oblation,’ fire or its deity Agni;
fear, alarm, apprehension (= भय, according to
Śabda-k.; perhaps fr. हुत + 1. आ-शा, but this sense
is doubtless modern).
—हुताशन (˚त-अश्˚), अस्, m.
‘oblation-eating,’ fire or its deity; epithet of Śiva.
—हुताशन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, bearing or holding
consecrated fire (said of an altar &c.).
—हुताशन-
सहाय, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva.
—हुताहुति (˚त-
आह्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, having an oblation just offered.

2. हुत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see p. 1174, col. 2),
called, summoned, invited.
हूत हूत, हूति, &c. See under rt. ह्वे.
हूत, अस्, आ, अम्, called, summoned, invited.

1. हुति, इस्, f. (for 2. see under rt. ह्वे), offering
oblations.

हूति, इस्, f. calling; invocation; calling defiantly,
challenging.
हुत्वा, ind. having offered (as an oblation &c.).
हूत्वा, ind. having called, having challenged.
